cards.title: Parenting a Teenage Rebel: Karma Comes Full Circle
cards.body: A parent who was a sullen, difficult teen now faces the challenge of raising an adolescent with similar tendencies. The experience of parenting mirrors the behavior parents once exhibited, creating an ironic full-circle moment.

cards.title: The Secret Behind Bedtime Stalling
cards.body: Bedtime resistance isn't simple defiance—it's children's clumsy way of requesting connection when they need it most. Small parenting adjustments can transform bedtime into a calmer experience for the whole family.

cards.title: Teaching Kids Kindness Through Acts of Service
cards.body: Parents can instill values by helping children understand that acts of kindness connect them to something bigger than themselves. Growing up noticing others and caring about the world creates compassionate, grounded adults.

cards.title: Kids' Quiz: Fun Brain-Teasing Questions
cards.body: A lighthearted quiz designed by children tests parent and family knowledge on quirky topics like why lollipops are called lollipops. Parents can also submit their children's original questions for future quizzes.
